name: Kabir Vaidya
player_statement:
A complete player, Kabir Vaidya has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 23, with an average of 6.70 and a quick strike rate of 58.26. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 8 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 23.0 overs, taking 9 wickets at an economy rate of 7.61. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
